name: externals
description: Other people's repos and packages this workspace uses (MCP servers, CLIs, skill packs), pinned in 02-shared-references/externals.json. These runs only read: what is installed on this device, whether the tracked wiring matches the manifest, the live parity proof, and the offline self-test. Adding, updating and removing take arguments and go through a reviewed plan (--expect-plan), not this runner.

status.description: Each external on this device: pinned vs installed (ok, missing, drift)

check.description: Does the tracked wiring (.mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json, skill links, allowlist rows) match the manifest? No network

verify-rea.description: Live parity for REA: integrity, every file, every command, the MCP catalog, inside vs outside the workspace

self-test.description: Offline cases for the manager itself; case names are stable for a port to match
